summary: TORONTO, Nov. 11, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Thomson Reuters (TSX/Nasdaq: TRI), a global content and technology company, today announced that it plans to repurchase up to $500 million of its shares. Purchases of shares will occur under a new normal course issuer bid (NCIB) that has been approved by the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX).
title: Thomson Reuters Announces $500 Million Share Repurchase Program and New Normal Course Issuer Bid

summary: AURORA, Ontario, Nov. 11, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Magna International Inc. (TSX: MG; NYSE: MGA) is holding an Investor Day this morning in New York City, where it will showcase The Power of Magna. The presentation materials include new and compelling mid-term financial targets covering the period through 2030. The targets reflect Magna's strategy to grow above market, execute with excellence and deploy capital with discipline.
title: Magna Unveils 2030 Financial Targets at Investor Day
